description: 15 道信息不完整的问数题。slots 用于 P5（该不该反问），answer/gold_sql 用于 P5.5（用户补充后能否收敛到正确 SQL）。

slot_legend.scope: 统计对象是哪张表/哪个业务

questions.question: 最近销售额怎么样？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(pay_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'

questions.question: 哪个品类卖得最好？
questions.why: 缺少时间范围，也没说按销售额还是销量
questions.answer: 2025 年，按销售额算，只要告诉我品类名就行。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(oi.item_amount) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 退款率是多少？
questions.why: 缺少时间范围，也没说退款率的算法
questions.answer: 2025 年全年整体，退款金额除以销售额再乘 100，给我一个百分比数值。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(refund_amount) FROM refunds WHERE status = '已完成' AND refund_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND refund_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01') / (SELECT SUM(pay_amount) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01') * 100, 2)

questions.question: 各渠道的数据怎么样？
questions.why: 没说要哪些指标，也没说时间范围
questions.answer: 2025 年，我要每个渠道的销售额和有效订单数，按渠道名分组。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.channel_name, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders o JOIN channels c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC

questions.question: Top 5 商品是哪些？
questions.why: 缺少排序依据和时间范围
questions.answer: 2025 年，按销售额从高到低，给我商品名称和销售额。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount), 2) AS amt FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY amt DESC, p.product_name LIMIT 5

questions.question: 用户复购率如何？
questions.why: 缺少时间范围，也没说复购怎么定义
questions.answer: 2025 年，复购率 = 有效订单不少于 2 笔的用户数 / 有下单的用户数 × 100，给我一个百分比。
questions.gold_sql: WITH u AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY user_id) SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c >= 2) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) FROM u

questions.question: 各会员等级表现如何？
questions.why: 没说看什么指标，也没说时间范围
questions.answer: 2025 年，每个会员等级的销售额和订单数，等级缺失的算「未知」。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(u.member_level, '未知'), ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY amt DESC

questions.question: 同比表现怎么样？
questions.why: 没说哪一年对哪一年，也没说看哪个指标
questions.answer: 看销售额，2025 年对比 2024 年的同比增长率，只要给我增长率这一个百分比数值。
questions.gold_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT SUM(pay_amount) AS amt FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'), b AS (SELECT SUM(pay_amount) AS amt FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01') SELECT ROUND((a.amt - b.amt) / b.amt * 100, 2) FROM a, b

questions.question: 帮我看下数据
questions.why: 既没有指标也没有对象
questions.answer: 看订单表，2025 年一共有多少笔订单。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'

questions.question: 退款情况汇总一下
questions.why: 没说要笔数、金额还是比率，也没说时间范围
questions.answer: 2025 年，给我已完成的退款金额合计和退款笔数，两个数一起。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2), COUNT(*) FROM refunds WHERE status = '已完成' AND refund_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND refund_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'

questions.question: 哪个省的用户最活跃？
questions.answer: 活跃 = 2025 年的有效订单数，给我订单数最多的那个省份和它的订单数。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT u.province, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND u.province IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC, u.province LIMIT 1

questions.question: 商品利润排行
questions.why: 「利润」口径未定，也没说时间范围
questions.answer: 2025 年，利润 = 明细金额 - 成本 × 数量，按利润从高到低给我前 5 个商品名称和利润。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount - p.cost * oi.quantity), 2) AS profit FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY profit DESC, p.product_name LIMIT 5

questions.question: 今年做得好吗？
questions.why: 没说看什么指标，也没说跟什么比
questions.answer: 看 2025 年销售额相对 2024 年的增长率，只要给我这一个百分比数值。
questions.gold_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT SUM(pay_amount) AS amt FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'), b AS (SELECT SUM(pay_amount) AS amt FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01') SELECT ROUND((a.amt - b.amt) / b.amt * 100, 2) FROM a, b

questions.question: 最近的退款和销售对比
questions.why: 缺时间范围，也没说对比什么指标
questions.answer: 2025 年全年的退款金额、销售额和退款率，一行三个数，退款率用百分比。
questions.gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT SUM(refund_amount) AS amt FROM refunds WHERE status = '已完成' AND refund_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND refund_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'), s AS (SELECT SUM(pay_amount) AS amt FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01') SELECT ROUND(r.amt, 2), ROUND(s.amt, 2), ROUND(r.amt / s.amt * 100, 2) FROM s, r

questions.question: 有多少活跃用户？
questions.why: 「活跃」没有定义，也没说时间范围
questions.answer: 活跃 = 2025 年下过有效订单的用户，给我去重后的用户数。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
